nodes.description: Player.Map 'players' storage in BullsAndCows holding balances, referrer and name mappings
RoomInfo.List 'roomInfos' storage holding all rooms and their prize pools
Player.AUTHOR constant address that receives protocol dividends
SELL_PRICE_RATE constant (200) used to scale the sell fee
SELL_MIN_RATE constant (50) minimum sell price ratio
msg.sender - externally controlled caller address
block.timestamp / now - externally influenced time source
tx.origin - externally controlled origin address used in randomness
External value transfer msg.sender.transfer(sum) after balance deletion in BullsAndCows.withdrawal
Weak randomness derived from blockhash/block.coinbase/block.difficulty/block.gaslimit/now/tx.origin in CommUtils.random
Unchecked subtraction (sum-num) and delete-before-require in Player.withdrawal
Unchecked chained subtraction of lessFee in RoomInfo.saveReplyFee and RoomInfo.buyReply
Unchecked multiplication/addition overflow in CommUtils.getHash and CommUtils.pwrFloat
BullsAndCows.withdrawal() - clears player balance then transfers ether to msg.sender
BullsAndCows.registerName(string) payable - registers a name and deposits the author share
BullsAndCows.createRoom(...) payable - creates a room and initializes its prize pool
BullsAndCows.replayAnser(uint256,uint256[]) payable - charges the reply fee and submits a guess
BullsAndCows.replayAnserWithReferrer(...) - applies a referrer before submitting a guess
BullsAndCows.sellReply(uint256,uint256,uint256) payable - lists a reply for sale
BullsAndCows.buyReply(uint256,uint256) payable - buys a reply and splits msg.value
BullsAndCows.award(uint256) - pays winners, rotates and deletes rooms
BullsAndCows.getPlayerWallet() view - returns the caller balance
BullsAndCows.getRoom(uint256) view - returns room configuration
BullsAndCows.isEmptyName(string) view - checks whether a filtered name is free
BullsAndCows.getInitInfo() view - returns room count and caller referrer name
Player.deposit - adds v to ps.map[adr]
Player.depositAuthor - credits the AUTHOR constant address
Player.withdrawal - partial withdrawal with delete-before-require accounting
Player.withdrawalAll - deletes the whole balance of an address and returns it
Player.registerName - binds msg.sender to a name and credits the author
Player.withdrawalFee - charges a fee from msg.value or from the player balance
Player.applyReferrer - resolves and stores the caller referrer
Player.setReferrer - writes the referrer mapping
Player.getAmmount view - reads a player balance
Player.getByName view - resolves a name hash to an address
CommUtils.random view - pseudo random generator built from block/tx fields
CommUtils.genRandomArray view - builds a permutation array for the secret answer
CommUtils.mulRate pure - unsigned multiply then divide by 100
CommUtils.nameFilter - sanitizes a string and returns bytes32
CommUtils.pwrFloat pure - iterative multiplied ratio, unchecked
CommUtils.getHash pure - positional hash of an array with unchecked mul/add
CommUtils.removeByIdx pure - removes an element from an array
RoomInfo.init - validates and stores room configuration, seeds the answer
RoomInfo.replayAnser - scores a guess, saves the fee and records the reply
RoomInfo.saveReplyFee - splits the reply fee between dividends and the prize pool
RoomInfo.sendReplayDividend - distributes dividends to previous reply owners
RoomInfo.buyReply - charges buyFee, splits dividends and pays the seller
RoomInfo.sellReply - lists a reply for sale and charges the fee
RoomInfo.award - computes winners, rewards and the next round prize
RoomInfo.getReplyFee - increases the reply fee by rate and grand count
RoomInfo.clearAndNextRound - resets replies and generates a new answer
RoomInfo.getEmpty - returns a free room slot, growing size
RoomInfo.getWinReply - selects the winning or last reply
RoomInfo.getOverTimeLeft view - remaining award time computed from now
RoomInfo.getByPrizeLeast - returns the room with the smallest prize
PlayerReply.setSellPrice - requires ownership then stores seller and price
PlayerReply.getVisibleType view - visibility based on owner, buyer and now
PlayerReply.countByGrand view - counts recent replies inside the grand window
PlayerReply.getOrGenByAnwser - creates a reply entry keyed by its hash
PlayerReply.clear - deletes all reply entries of a room
PlayerReply.getWin - scans replies for a winning one
PlayerReply.listBestScore - returns the best aCount/bCount and count

roomIdx parameter of BullsAndCows.replayAnser
tryA player guess array
price parameter of BullsAndCows.sellReply
replyIdx parameter of BullsAndCows.buyReply
adr account parameter of Player.withdrawal

replayFee parameter of RoomInfo.saveReplyFee

max modulus parameter of CommUtils.random

prize parameter of RoomInfo.award

name string parameter of BullsAndCows.registerName
local sum of the caller balance in BullsAndCows.withdrawal

local hashVal accumulation in CommUtils.random
local nextRound prize in RoomInfo.award
local reward amount after removing nextRound in RoomInfo.award
